ops-bot: ALERT: Canary cluster 'canary-east-3' reporting elevated 5xx rate >= 8% over 2m, aborting rollout rc-2026-03-15-3. Automatic kill-switch engaged. Paging on-call.
deploy-bot: Deploy rc-2026-03-15-3 started 2160004200, canary nodes: 6 -> 6, route: fastpath. Rollout id: r-0a1b2c
anjali: I'm on it. seeing healthcheck failures on /health (503) from two pods. pulling logs.
mike: I just got the page. any customer impact? which customers on this cluster?
erin-csm: FYI a couple of small customers had higher latency alerts earlier but no direct error reports yet. I'll stand by to notify if we escalate.
anjali: logs: ```
2026-03-15T12:12:08Z ERROR model-server request failed status=503 target=kv-cache
2026-03-15T12:12:09Z WARN healthprobe failed path=/health check=readiness
``` 
anjali: also seeing spike in connection reset counts and OOMKilled on one canary pod (pod-3). root cause still unclear.
ryan: rolling abort flag now true. command I ran: `./deployctl rollback --id r-0a1b2c --mode immediate --reason "canary 5xx >= 8%"`
deploy-bot: Rollback action queued by ryan. Expected completion in ~30s. Canary traffic removed from fastpath.
mike: Good. Any config changes in this rollout? feature flags? quantization toggles?
anjali: This rollout included kv-cache experimental change + a batching tweak (batch_size default bumped). suspect kv-cache invalidation bug causing downstream 503s.
ryan: I'm flipping the kill-switch flag `feature:kv-cache-experimental` back to off for canary scope. `ffctl set kv-cache-experimental off --scope canary-east-3`
ops-bot: NOTE: Pager escalation for high-severity issue suppressed after rollback. Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-73. Channel #incidents linked.
erin-csm: I'll prepare a short customer update template: "We've detected increased errors on a small canary during a rollout. The release was aborted and we're investigating. No broad customer impact detected." Want approval to send to affected accounts.
mike: approve. keep it targeted.
anjali: Post-rollback status: all pods stable, healthchecks passing on canary nodes for 2m. No new 5xx observed. collecting traces and heap dumps from pod-3.
ryan: capturing core dump now, will upload to S3: s3://redwood-debug/canary/2160004321/
anjali: Triage next steps: 1) reproduce locally with kv-cache toggle, 2) run load test for batch_size change, 3) audit changelog for memory/alloc differences. I'll own 1+2.
mike: I'll take ownership of customer comms and follow-up with sales for any escalations.
erin-csm: thanks. tagging affected accounts list and sending targeted note. will update within 30m.
anjali: marking incident as 'mitigated' for now but keeping open until root cause confirmed. moving to on-call handoff for night shift.
ryan: handing off to night on-call @maria-night (cc:ops). summary: rollback completed, canary healthy, suspected kv-cache invalidation + batching interplay. artifacts: logs + core dump in S3.
ops-bot: HANDOFF: oncall-night will take over at 2160004389. Please add any unresolved action items to the incident ticket INC-2026-03-15-73.
anjali: thanks team :thumbsup:
